limits: Report explicitly covers first_three_rules only, not the full quality contract.
An old output is preserved on a failed run; callers must check the current command exit status before treating it as a new report.
REVIEW and PASS exit 0, while BLOCK exits 2 even though a valid report is saved; execution errors exit 1.
No local execution or design explanation by the applicant is inferred from Codex runs.
Existing applicant SQL, validation/loading submissions and v2 human measurement remain completed evidence; remaining full-project work is separate.
